name: Triple-barrier meta-labeled basis-discount reversion — macro-gated sizing
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from both existing meta-label specs — metalabel-momentum [primary = momentum] and metalabel-reversion [primary = RSI]; here the PRIMARY is a perp-spot basis discount and the SECONDARY model reads a MACRO+vol feature set, so both the side-signal and the gating context are new): meta-labeling (Lopez de Prado) keeps a permissive primary and learns when to act. The primary is the basis-discount contrarian long (perp_spot_basis below a fitted discount floor = over-short crowd, a short-squeeze setup on spot) — a real but regime-dependent edge. The secondary regularized logistic is trained expanding-window, point-in-time, on which barrier (stop/take/time) each past basis-discount entry hit first net of cost, reading at entry: the basis itself, realized vol, perp funding, equity VIX and crypto DVOL. The thesis the secondary tests: basis-squeeze reversions PAY in calm macro/low-IV regimes and FAIL when a deflating discount is just the front edge of a systemic risk-off cascade — so it should size UP the squeeze when macro is calm and SKIP it when VIX/DVOL/funding flag stress. Proportional sizing scales conviction by the predicted win probability. It only sizes/skips, never flips direction. Disconfirmer 1 (honest prior): meta-labeling only amplifies an edge the primary already has — if the bare basis-discount long has no edge after ~20bps, this is a powered FAIL, which is the point of running it cleanly. Disconfirmer 2: if the macro features in the secondary carry no information (dropping VIX/DVOL leaves the gate unchanged), the macro-gating thesis is unsupported and this reduces to a vol-gated basis spec. Disconfirmer 3: the secondary must be ungated until META_MIN_TRAIN resolved events exist, so it can only ever SUBTRACT primary trades — no look-ahead. tier0 basis + tier0 macro features.
catalyst: secondary model green-lights a basis-discount squeeze in a calm macro/low-IV regime
